crossRefs.note: who does great things that can’t be fathomed, marvelous things without number;
Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunder storm,
“Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, That abundance of waters may cover you?
No plant of the field was yet in the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for Yahweh God had not caused…
but a mist went up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground.
You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain…
I will lay it a wasteland. It won’t be pruned or hoed, but it will grow briers and thorns. I will also command the…

lightning and hail, snow and clouds; stormy wind, fulfilling his word;
